title: Noor and the Ember
author: R. M. Montrose
blurb: August Eriksen, a beast-speaker hiding a forbidden gift, has spent fifteen years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. Then tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
